items.title: Gas Prices Are Dropping at a 2008 Pace Right Before Thanksgiving
items.summary: Pump prices are tumbling toward a possible Thanksgiving record, yet the 2008 comparison breaks down on closer inspection. Behind the cheaper fill-ups sits a shipping lane that could squeeze the biggest energy fund even harder.

items.title: How Many Shares of Chevron, Shell or Exxon Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about $360,000 of Shell stock, $351,300 of Chevron or $448,600 of ExxonMobil. All three cover their dividends comfortably, paying out between 27% and 41% of free cash flow over their latest twelve months.

items.title: TechnipFMC (FTI) Stock May Be 43% Undervalued Following Guyana Contract Win
items.summary: TechnipFMC has delivered very strong multi year gains, yet the real question for you today is whether the current share price lines up with the cash flows the business can produce. After a run like this and with fresh contract wins in the subsea business, it is fair to ask if the market price still reflects what those cash flows are worth. items.title: ExxonMobil Secures Government Approval for Revised Rovuma LNG Plan
items.summary: XOM secures Mozambique's approval for a revised Rovuma LNG plan, lifting capacity to 18.6 MTPA while targeting lower costs and emissions.

items.title: 3 Dividend ETFs Offering Steadier Footing in a Shaky Market
items.summary: SCHD, LVHI, and VYM have held up better than the S&P 500 amid the recent tech sell-off, offering lower-volatility dividend ETF options for investors seeking stability without exiting stocks.

items.title: How Retirees Can Turn $750,000 Into Passive Income With These 5 Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Selling shares during a market drop can wreck a retirement plan. Five dividend payers from five different sectors offer another path, but each one carries a hidden risk that could threaten the paycheck, from biosimilars to interest rates.

items.title: TechnipFMC Deepens ExxonMobil Ties With Guyana Longtail Awards
items.summary: FTI deepens its XOM partnership with two Guyana Longtail awards, expanding subsea work as the $12.5B offshore project targets 2030 production.
